description: This file is the main package documentation for the 'app' package in Mattermost, describing its architecture, core components, design patterns, responsibilities, and error handling. It provides an overview of the business logic layer that sits between the API and data access layers.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main entry point for business logic operations, stateless, constructed per request, associated with Channels.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Manages HTTP server, routing, middleware, service lifecycle, enterprise features, clustering, and runtime environment.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Contains channels-related state and enterprise interface implementations, manages plugins, file storage, image processing, and enterprise features like compliance, LDAP, and SAML.

methods.name: Request Context Pattern
methods.description: All business logic methods accept a request.CTX parameter for request-scoped logging, tracing, and cancellation.

methods.name: Interface Segregation
methods.description: Enterprise features are accessed through interfaces in the einterfaces package, allowing modular enterprise functionality.

methods.name: Dependency Injection
methods.description: Services and dependencies are injected through the Server and Channels structs, enabling testability and modularity.

methods.name: Event-Driven Architecture
methods.description: Uses WebSocket events and plugin hooks for real-time updates and extensibility.
